notes.title: Grateful free update (1.0.4)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948935/1b4dfbe56ecf17d692688110248c02d8781dc991.png[/img]
To commemorate the visit of many gentlemen and ladies, "Free Appreciation Update (Patch 1.0.4)" was released today.
This update adds "Cheki Pose" and "Present Pants".
Five types of Cheki Pose and five types of Pants will be added for each cast member as gifts.
Both will appear as the game progresses.
